public static class SubjectModule
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Registers this assembly's toolsets, agents and JSON contexts, once per service collection.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="services">The services.</param>
    public static void Register(global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection services)
    {
